scope: Bounded native Current Core Meta Model and Project Configuration source scan of Form lists and policy propagation. No actual Workflow instances, runtime or legacy metadata migration.

findings.finding: Details explicitly exclude Operations Form Decision. Amend that exclusion for the newly admitted Decision while retaining valid Action/Workflow/Step admission and keeping Branch/Fork and Step-structure distinctions.

Requires every Operations Claim to use exactly one of three type profiles Action/Workflow/Step. Scope Delegation, Solution, Direct Policy, Approach Policy and Decision need applicable Claim profiles or a narrower explicitly scoped rule; preserve the existing three profiles for their Forms.

Explicit Operations filename token map lists only Action/Workflow/Step and does not specify newly admitted Forms. Coordinate general effective-Label/Form filename authority; retain existing entries without inventing new token policy. This is not evidence that the model forbids the new Forms.

non_conflicts: CA-R-1506 explicitly leaves Evaluation Form domain open; a check-specific Form is not a closed list.
CA-R-1565 includes Action, Workflow, Step; its positive inclusion is not itself an exhaustive list.
CA-E-387 validates separately admitted values; it does not itself enumerate or ban the proposed Forms.
limitations: No additional mandatory local Policy-copy or leaf-only realization requirement was found in the bounded scan beyond previously reported R1767/R2123/R1671/R1672/R1768. This does not prove absence outside scope.
R2149 relation and tier direction, R924 and R2123 authority are separately tracked; the names of obsolete instance Forms are not themselves conflicts.
Candidate additions require separate admitted Form and serialization authority; no runtime pass or migration is claimed.
